description: This file `export_observation.py` contains a collection of functions to export behavioral observation data in various formats (e.g., tabular, aggregated, specific software formats). It includes methods to process observation events, convert them into textual sequences, and output files compatible with different analysis tools or formats, with support for different observation types like media, live, or images. The code also interacts with external modules for database operations, file handling, and project-specific data structures.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] export_events_jwatcher( parameters: dict, obsId: str, observation: list, ethogram: dict, file_name: str, output_format: str )
methods.description: Exports observation events in the JWatcher .dat format for each subject, including metadata and behavior codes, and creates associated .fmf, .faf files, etc.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] export_tabular_events( pj: dict, parameters: dict, obs_id: str, observation: dict, ethogram: dict, file_name: str, output_format: str )
methods.description: Exports behavioral event data into a tabular format (e.g., CSV, TSV, Excel), with detailed event and media information, per observation.

methods.name: tuple dataset_write(dataset: tablib.Dataset, file_name: str, output_format: str, dtype: dict = {})
methods.description: Handles writing a tablib dataset to various file formats, including Pandas pickle, RDS, CSV, Excel, HTML, etc., with error handling.

methods.name: Tuple[tablib.Dataset,int] export_aggregated_events(pj: dict, parameters: dict, obsId: str, force_number_modifiers: int = 0)
methods.description: Exports aggregated event data from a database for a given observation, with optional forcing of modifiers count, with per subject and behavior breakdown.

methods.name: str events_to_behavioral_sequences(pj, obs_id: str, subj: str, parameters: dict, behav_seq_separator: str)
methods.description: Generates string sequences of behaviors for a subject in an observation, optionally including modifiers and separating behaviors.

methods.name: str events_to_behavioral_sequences_all_subj(pj, obs_id: str, subjects_list: list, parameters: dict, behav_seq_separator: str)
methods.description: Generates concatenated behavioral sequences for all subjects in an observation.

methods.name: str events_to_timed_behavioral_sequences( pj: dict, obs_id: str, subject: str, parameters: dict, precision: float, behav_seq_separator: str )
methods.description: Creates a time-scan sample behavioral sequence string for a subject, based on specified precision.

methods.name: observation_to_behavioral_sequences(pj, selected_observations, parameters, behaviors_separator, separated_subjects, timed, file_name)
methods.description: Exports behavioral sequence data for selected observations to a text file, with details about observation type, media, and behaviors.
